(1) Missing fund column: the Debt Service Fund column (p5) has no schedule: Taxes 98,020 + Special assessment 702,827 + Special assessment interest 48,856 + Interest income 3,457 + Other revenues 2,325 = 855,485 (added). (2) Different basis (no fix): General budgetary 8,270,885 vs GAAP 9,021,109 = +750,224 (p11 'Accrual adjustment for receivables 750,224'); Street budgetary 3,675,394 (includes Warrant income 1,581,498 printed as revenue) vs GAAP 1,843,878 = -1,831,516; Keno budgetary 134,574 vs GAAP 136,683 = +2,109 (p15 accrual adjustment for receivables 2,109). Check: 855,485 + 750,224 - 1,831,516 + 2,109 = -223,698 = gap. After the fix the remaining -1,079,183 is entirely the budgetary-basis difference.
